STORY-1690 implementer: BLOCKED at the test-touched gate on a host resource floor, not on code.

Exact error (make test-touched, twice, 11:2x and 12:33):
  cargo: error: refusing build: target filesystem has 14.4G (3.1%) free, below hard floor (15G); run 'cargo reap --apply' or set AIDA_CARGO_DISK_MIN_GIB=0 to override
`cargo reap` (dry-run) finds 0 dirs to reap. I did not reap, override the floor, or use the slot bypass.

State:
- Branch claude/story-1690 PUSHED, head ddedea1c204098bae88fe4af2e5c81b7e2a3fb63. PR NOT opened (per brief: blocked -> mail and stop).
- Commit: "[AI:claude] feat(pr): merge train — land approved PRs only on a CI-tested stack, bisect red trains (STORY-1690)" — S2-S5 + folded TASK-1378 in one completing PR (REMAINING audit comment is on the spec).
- Passed: targeted `cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib pr_train` (17/17, incl. the regression demo: guard PR + offender PR each green alone; train lands the guard, ejects the offender, every produced main green), story_1728_command_registry (18/18, help snapshot regenerated), tests/test_merge_hold_gate.sh (7x2 + 9 new train-mode cases; fails on the old gate), make check-templates OK, make check-ci-fast 34/34.
- Not run: make test-touched (disk floor).

Notes for review: the sketch said GitHub's base check refuses a moved main; with strict:false it does not, so the train re-fetches main under the merge lease and refuses/rebuilds if main moved before the pinned rebase merge. GitLab train MRs get only the client-side member hold check (documented). serial-ship.sh lives in ~/.local/share/aida/ops (outside the repo); I left it — delete it once this merges and the live binary has `aida pr train`.

Next: once disk is above 15G, rerun `make test-touched` in /home/joe/ai/aida-worktrees/fin-story-1690 and open the PR — or tell me to proceed and I will.
subject: STORY-1690 blocked on test-touched disk floor; branch pushed at ddedea1c20
